datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2013, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing food insecurity classifications at four time points (January, April, July, October 2013), with each feature containing IPC phase values and metadata on collection date and scenario assumptions.
